note: Presentation only (UDinkEnvironmentSubsystem, DinkArtSubsystem). grass: a carpet of preferred_meshes (the dense patches, used when imported; meshes is the fallback) in 8 m cells around the camera, thinned to nothing at far_cm by the scatter material; accent_meshes are the sparse taller clumps, weeds and flowers. mesh_swaps: old stylised vegetation of the authored screens -> photoreal meshes (visual only, the authored component stays as the collision proxy). layer_cover.json beside this file is generated by Scripts/export_import_bundle.py. grass.scale_* is the footprint scale of a patch, grass.height_* its height scale (taller, more upright blades than the authored 0.25 m patch); lean_deg tilts each patch. mesh_swaps also covers the Stonebrook split-rail fence (intact runs only: the broken variant in the yard read as a derelict farm) and the field boulders (photoreal Structures kit, 12 Nov 2026); the Stonebrook cottage of screen 439 only (mesh_swap_only_tag: the vista copies seen from the authored interior of screen 1 keep the old mesh) shows SM_Cottage_Stonebrook_PR; the old mesh stays the collision proxy. grass.field_variation: world noise and path wear vary the carpet's height and density; SM_Veg_GrassPatch_Tall_* replace the stretched low patches when imported (tall_height_*). Round 5: grass.short_meshes / dry_meshes / rank_meshes are roles wired by name (short turf where worn or grazed, dry drifts, rank tufts within rank_reach_cm of fences, walls, trunks, boulders and pond rims; wear within wear_reach_cm of doors and paths); accent_cluster is the drift threshold of weeds and flowers. indoor.lit_card_material relights sprite cards, indoor.flame_material and indoor.props put a flame and a prop at every lamp. state_swaps: a swapped mesh follows a screen vision (burnt cottage). Town houses: Content/Dink/Data/Art/town_houses.json (Scripts/assemble_town_houses.py). Round 6: grass.field_scale is the uniform scale of the field patch (0.62 of the 0.63 m Tall patch: a field near 0.35 m), short_reach_cm the width of the short turf along walls, fence lines, paths and doors, rank_edge_share the share of rank tufts kept right against walls and fences (trunks, boulders and pond rims keep all); the apron within about a third of wear_reach_cm of a door carries no grass. Round 6: grass.field_footprint is the footprint scale of the field patch (wider than tall keeps the ground covered). indoor.<look>.fill_intensity/fill_colour: an even unshadowed fill without inverse-square falloff (unitless); ceiling_cm/ceiling_material/ceiling_wall_class: a visible one-sided ceiling of ceiling_tile_cm planes over interiors that carry walls of that class prefix.

indoor.note: Indoor set (presentation only): enclosing hidden shell, inward black backdrop, lights, fixed exposure. skip_screens keep their authored lighting (screens an art manifest dresses are skipped as well). Intensities are candelas at the project's scene scale (sun 10). Round 7: <look>.ceiling_lamp_light false = lamps, fires and the ambient point do not light the ceiling planes (they sit on lighting channel 1, lit by the even fill only: no hot disc over a lantern or torch); lamp_source_cm = source radius of the shadowed lamps and fires (soft shadow edges). Interior: warm lamps as the key (26 cd), a cooler, lower fill (0.2) so corners fall off.

props.note: Light props of Props/manifest.json, wired by name. socket_cm is the flame socket in Unreal mesh space (Blender x, -y, z in cm); mount_cm the pivot height above the floor; flame_cm the flame card width and height.

burnable.note: Scripted pines the fireball burns (die -> sp_seq 20, then sp_pseq 89, the secret stairs picture): the dry pine before, the burnt pine from the burn on. show_card false: the placement card stays hidden, because it keeps the green pine picture whatever the script sets (placement cards are not redrawn from script state); set it true once they are, and the fire card plays over the burnt pine and the stairs picture stands alone. Read-only on the script state.

state_swaps.note: Screen 439 after the fire (s1-h1-o.c: &story > 4 sets &vision 2, which shows the burn-hole placements): the swapped-in cottage becomes its burnt mesh and the burn-hole cards it models are hidden. Read from whether a placement gated by that vision is shown; nothing is written.

forest.note: Trees on the unwalkable forest-canopy tiles (the 1997 tiles paint a closed pine forest there; the terrain layer under it is leaf litter). The world export lists the points per screen in ground_classes.json `trees` (map x, map y, 1 on the forest's edge), never on ground a player can reach. Visual only, no collision; dink.Forest 0 turns it off. meshes: one per point, by a stable hash; interior_fill: share of the points behind the edge rows that carry a tree (nobody at the play camera sees past the edge rows); understory_meshes: at the feet of the edge trees (understory_share of them).

relief.note: Rock standing on cliff-face, rock-mass and cave-wall tiles (the 1997 tiles paint rock that stands up; the terrain layer under it is flat). The world export lists the points per screen in ground_classes.json `relief` (map x, map y, clear radius in px, tier, class): tier 1 = the 1997 hardness blocks the whole disc, tier 2 = the only walkable ground in the disc is an enclosed pocket no walking player can enter. Visual only, no collision. dink.Relief: 0 off, 1 tier 1 only (default), 2 both tiers. Each rock is scaled so its footprint stays inside the clear radius (fill x radius).

water_tiles.note: Water surface over the water tiles of screens whose collision has no water fill (ground_classes.json `water_tiles`). Visual only, no collision; dink.WaterTiles 0 turns it off.

sky.note: Colour of the sky light (multiplies the captured sky). Round 6: shaded cream plaster read teal; set from the cal2 comparison with the Cycles review frames. cal2 s6 (House_street, plaster in the eaves shadow, sRGB): Cycles 46,38,27 (R/B 1.70); engine at tint 1,1,1: 54,56,52 (R/B 1.04); at 1,0.9,0.74: 58,55,45 (1.29). 1,0.88,0.66 is a compromise: warmer would yellow all foliage shade.

decals.note: Round 6: sprite classes shown as deferred ground decals (Props/Decals, 2 x 2 atlases: one material instance per cell, picked by a stable hash of the origin). Visual only; scripted or animated placements keep their card.
